name: Welwitschia Goth

fashion.Overview: Welwitschia Goth developed within the overlapping circles of the Emo and Goth communities, and its fashion reflects this intersection, adding macabre accents to the fundamental dark alternative look. Fashion takes the basic foundation of Mallgoth and augments it with elements of stylized horror. Clothing includes striped socks, pointy or chunky platform shoes, and dresses accented with ribbons, bows, or lace. The look is often completed by adopting the signature exaggerated Emo makeup style, featuring heavy black eyeliner and extremely pale skin.
